title: Gemini Flash 3.6 is missing from the model selector

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report stating that Gemini Flash 3.6 is missing from the manual model selector options in CLI v0.51.0.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Adding the missing Flash model option to the manual model selection list in ModelDialog.tsx involves a localized logic update in a single UI component.

summary.problem: When choosing a model manually in the CLI model dialog, Gemini Flash 3.6 is missing from the available selector options.
summary.root_cause: The manual model options list in ModelDialog.tsx omits the Gemini Flash 3.5/3.6 model constant from manualModels and manualOptions.
summary.context: ModelDialog.tsx defines options for manual model selection but lacks the constant for the 3.5/3.6 Flash model.

steps: Include DEFAULT_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL in manualModels array and manualOptions list so it appears in the model selection dialog.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The Flash model option appears in the list of available models when opening manual model selection.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in ModelDialog.test.tsx to verify that DEFAULT_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL is rendered in manual model options.
